---
title: "Can the aircraft be optimised further?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Show code"
setup = baseline_setup()
design = optimise(setup["limits"])
optimised = build_airplane(design["span"], design["chords"], design["twists"])


verdicts = []
for label, analysis, offset, options in [
    ("AeroBuildup", asb.AeroBuildup, setup["drag_offset"], {}),
    ("LiftingLine", asb.LiftingLine, 0.0, dict(spanwise_resolution=8)),
]:
    verdicts.append((
        label,
        best_glide(analysis, AIRPLANE, setup["speed"], offset, **options),
        best_glide(analysis, optimised, design["speed"], offset, **options),
    ))

gains = [(after / before - 1) * 100 for _, before, after in verdicts]
tip_reynolds = (design["chords"][-1] * design["speed"]
                / asb.Atmosphere(altitude=0.0).kinematic_viscosity())

# The structural constraint is only as good as the proxy that enforced it, and
# the proxy was never checked on a planform this different from the baseline.
# Both are measured against the real vortex-lattice integration here, so a proxy
# that stopped being honest on the new shape fails the render.
for airplane, span, chords in [(AIRPLANE, SPAN, list(STATION_C)),
                               (optimised, design["span"], design["chords"])]:
    load = spanwise_load(LIMIT_LOAD_FACTOR * MASS * GRAVITY / 2,
                         airplane=airplane, speed=45.0, alpha=6.0)
    shear = np.cumsum(load["strip_force"][::-1])[::-1]
    true_moment = float(np.cumsum((shear * load["width"])[::-1])[::-1][0])
    proxy = float(root_bending_proxy(span, chords))
    assert abs(proxy / true_moment - 1) < 0.05, \
        f"bending proxy is {proxy / true_moment:.3f} of the real moment"

# The finding IS the disagreement, so it is asserted rather than described.
assert gains[0] > 0 > gains[1], "the two methods no longer disagree in sign"
```

::: {.hero-pair}
::: {}
[`{python} f"{gains[0]:+.1f}"`%]{.hero-value}
[AeroBuildup, the model optimised]{.hero-label}
:::
::: {}
[`{python} f"{gains[1]:+.1f}"`%]{.hero-value .hero-ref}
[LiftingLine, on the same design]{.hero-label}
:::
:::

**Answer.** Not credibly. The optimiser gains
[`{python} f"{gains[0]:.1f}"`]{.key}% by its own model's reckoning, stretching
span to [`{python} f"{design['span']:.2f}"`]{.key} m until bending binds — but
LiftingLine judges that same design [`{python} f"{abs(gains[1]):.1f}"`]{.key}%
*worse* (@fig-verdict). The sign disagreement makes the gain a model artefact.
It is bought where that model is weakest: tip chord
[`{python} f"{design['chords'][-1]:.3f}"`]{.key} m, halving tip Reynolds to
[`{python} f"{tip_reynolds:.2e}"`]{.key}.

::: {.callout-warning}
## The design never pays for its span

Mass is held at `{python} f"{MASS:.0f}"` kg however far the wing grows, so span
costs bending moment but never weight. Twist also ran to its bound.
:::

```{python}
#| label: fig-verdict
#| fig-cap: "Best glide ratio of the baseline and the optimised design, with each method judged on its own terms. AeroBuildup carries the calibration fitted to it; LiftingLine is read raw, so it is the direction and size of each change that compares between them, not the absolute heights."
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.0, 3.2))

for (label, before, after), colour in zip(verdicts, ["C0", "C1"]):
    ax.plot([0, 1], [before, after], "-o", color=colour, ms=7, label=label, zorder=3)
    ax.annotate(f"{(after / before - 1) * 100:+.1f}%", xy=(1, after), xytext=(10, 0),
                textcoords="offset points", va="center", color=colour,
                fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")

ax.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax.set_xticklabels(["baseline", "optimised"])
ax.set_xlim(-0.12, 1.30)
ax.set_ylabel("Best glide ratio")
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(loc="lower left")
plt.show()
```
